name: robotbase
description: Give your coding agent a robot to build and test — ROS 2 + Gazebo simulations driven entirely from the robotbase CLI. Bundles the robotbase skill so your agent knows the declarative build/test loop (specs + a controller you write + scenarios that pass/fail on real assertions), from an empty session through a passing run. Requires Docker and `pip install robotbase-kit` (or uvx).
